test_cases.Input: Enter empty values for both username and password, click 'Login' button
test_cases.Expected Output: Required field error displayed for either Username or Password field

test_cases.Input: Enter an invalid email address (e.g., example.com) as the username, click 'Login' button
test_cases.Expected Output: Required field error displayed if no '@' symbol found in input

test_cases.Input: Enter a password with less than 8 characters, click 'Login' button
test_cases.Expected Output: Required field error displayed for Password field

test_cases.Input: Enter a valid email address as the username and a password of at least 8 characters, click 'Login' button
test_cases.Expected Output: Successful login or redirect to another page (if implemented)

test_cases.Description: Validate error message for empty required fields
test_cases.Input: Enter empty values for both username and password, click 'Login' button without any error message present
test_cases.Expected Output: "Required field" error displayed for either Username or Password field if error message is not shown initially

test_cases.Description: Validate error message for invalid email address (no '@')
test_cases.Input: Enter an invalid email address (e.g., example.com) as the username, click 'Login' button without any error message present
test_cases.Expected Output: "Required field" error displayed if no '@' symbol found in input, and additional error message indicating missing '@' symbol in email address

test_cases.Description: Validate error message for password length (less than 8 characters)
test_cases.Input: Enter a password with less than 8 characters, click 'Login' button without any error message present
test_cases.Expected Output: "Required field" error displayed for Password field, and additional error message indicating password length is less than the required 8 characters
